title: Semantic Enrichments Fields (part of composed schema)
description: Semantic enrichments fields of media content items in the Impresso project.

ocrqa_f.description: OCR quality assessment score between 0.00 and 1.00, or null if unavailable.

topics_dpfs.description: Topics assigned to the content item.

cluster_id_ss.description: TR Cluster IDs assigned to the content item.

gte_multi_v768.description: Content item embedding as a vector of floats.
